label: adjustmentHasStyle: an adjustment layer reports a style to edit
adjustmentHelpless: an adjustment layer's style commands say nothing
noLayerHelpless: with no layer the style commands say nothing
find: guard selectedLayer != nil else { return StyleRules.noLayerHelp }
replace: guard selectedLayer != nil else { return nil }

label: panelStuck: showStylePanel never opens the panel
adjustmentLayersNotSkipped: an adjustment layer takes the style (adjustmentLayersRefuse, anAdjustmentLayerInTheSelectionIsSkipped)
dragIgnored: a drag's sets are many steps (dragIsOneStep)
primaryOnly: only the primary layer takes the style (twoSelectedLayersTakeTheStyleInOneStep)
find: for at in targets { layers[at].style = clamped }
replace: if let at = targets.last { layers[at].style = clamped }
